REVIEW: approve ebbb589243283c7b9f2bda3e906bbcfd712a8ec3

Reviewed as grok (different vendor from bf-author claude/claude-orch). 2 files: src/live.rs + tests/cli_polish.rs. Required check `check` SUCCESS on this SHA. MERGEABLE/CLEAN.

PRs screen: background gh fetch every 60s, first snapshot waits ≤1.5s so BF_TUI_ONCE carries real counts, failure keeps last rows and sets prs_stale_since. Transcript tails: last 64 KiB, 40 messages × 200 chars, (mtime,len) cache, 60 ms budget, Claude registry → project jsonl. Unit tests cover Claude/Codex/Cursor/Grok shapes; cli_polish covers fixture PRs 2 open and gh-outage stale-since-never.

Follow-up (not blocking): on first-wait timeout, `refresh_prs` returns with `prs_settled` still false, so later snapshots keep `recv_timeout(1.5s)` until gh answers. Comment says only the first snapshot waits. Set `prs_settled = true` on that timeout so the loader uses try_recv afterwards. Event loop is already off-thread so this is a hitch, not a freeze.

Merging with rebase --delete-branch.
